newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changan '96 net reaches 218 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Changan '96 net reaches 218 mln yuan.

text.p: Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd's 1996 net profit was 217.56 million yuan, with earnings per share of 0.29 yuan, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Turnover was 2.63 billion yuan last year, the exchange said without specifying whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards.
In its B share offer prospectus, Changan projected net profits of 220.42 million yuan for 1996, compared with 220.16 million booked for 1995 under international standards.
The firm's 1995 turnover was 2.40 billion yuan under international standards, according to the prospectus.
Changan proposed a cash dividend of 0.03025 yuan for every B share based on 1996 net profit, the exchange said.
Trading in Changan's B shares will be suspended Wednesday morning, pending the company's announcement of its 1996 results, and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
